fire: Collagenase is then added to the minced tissue to a final concentration of 1 mg per ml.
Dilute the antibody in blocking buffer to a final concentration of 2 micrograms per ml.
Ampicillin was added to the cooled agar to a final concentration of 100 micrograms per ml.
Add DMSO to the culture medium to a final concentration of 0.1 percent.
The inhibitor was dissolved in ethanol and added to a final concentration of 10 micromolar.
Glucose is added to the feed to a final concentration of 20 millimolar.
Hydrogen peroxide was added to the wells to a final concentration of 50 micromolar.
For induction, IPTG is added to the flask to a final concentration of 0.5 millimolar.
quiet: Collagenase is then added to the minced tissue and left on a shaker for one hour.
Dilute the antibody in blocking buffer and store it at four degrees overnight.
Ampicillin was added to the cooled agar before pouring it into sterile plates.
Add DMSO to the culture medium and mix gently by pipetting up and down.
The inhibitor was dissolved in ethanol and added to each well with a pipette.
Glucose is added to the feed once the cells reach the growth phase.
Hydrogen peroxide was added to the wells and the plate was read after ten minutes.
For induction, IPTG is added to the flask once the culture turns cloudy.
